mentions.name: EU-hosted e-commerce and POS platform
mentions.description: An e-commerce and point-of-sale (POS) platform comparable to Shopify, Saleor, and WooCommerce, designed to be ready-to-start for small businesses selling physical, online, and in-store products and services. It is built on Elysia/Bun and TanStack, fully hosted in the EU, and uses an EU-based payment processor with an ISV partnership.
mentions.audience: Small businesses selling physical, online, and in-store products and services
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a e-commerce and pos solution. More like shopify/saleor/woocommerce etc. with ready to start for small businesses selling physical and online and in-store products and services.
